output.reason: [ev-cb004eb264ca] says only that `istioctl experimental injector list` gained namespace filtering. That is a new, optional capability of a client-side subcommand, not a container argument of Istio's workloads. The proposed cli-flag leaf (named "experimental injector list" and set) treats a subcommand as a workload flag, so it misdescribes the environment state. No manifest, Helm value or workload configuration shows whether operators run this istioctl subcommand, so exposure can only be stated as undecidable.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds optional namespace filtering to the client-side `istioctl experimental injector list` command. No workload configuration shows who is exposed: it depends only on whether operators run this subcommand, which static environment inputs do not carry.

exposure.needed: whether operators run the client-side `istioctl experimental injector list` command, which no cluster manifest or Helm value records
